7602 / 7609: Cortech Endurance Nightstand
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7602-endurance-night-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-nightstand/
Spec sheets: 7602 / 7609, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Nightstand – 7602 / 7609
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Night Table - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 7602
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Bedside Table with Open Shelving and Optional Laminate Top
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 7602 Night Stand / 7609 Night Stand with Laminate Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Nightstand is a one-piece molded bedside table with molded-in shelving for open storage of personal items. It gives patient rooms and housing units a durable nightstand with 2 cu ft of storage and no doors or drawers.
The nightstand is rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It can be bolted to the floor or wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice, and it comes with a plain molded top (7602) or a smooth laminate top (7609).
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Storage: Molded-in open shelving, 2 cu ft
Dimensions: 21”W×18”D×22”H
Weight: 26 lbs
Top: Plain molded top (7602) or optional smooth laminate top (7609)
Mounting: Bolts to the floor or wall through concealed pilot holes
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the all-plastic model; 5-year warranty on the laminate top
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7602 – Plain Top: 21”W×18”D×22”H, 26 lbs
7609 – Laminate Top: 21”W×18”D×22”H, smooth laminate top
Installation and Options
Mounting: Bolt to the floor and wall through eight concealed mounting points with hardware of your choice; drill holes at least 2” deep; see Cortech instructions
Ballast: Optional sand ballasting
[H2] Applications
The Nightstand suits patient rooms and housing units that need a safe bedside table with open storage.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Residential treatment centers and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (55 characters): Cortech Endurance Nightstand - 7602 / 7609 at Anchortex
Meta description (155 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Nightstand. A one-piece molded bedside table with 2 cu ft of open shelving, a plain or laminate top, and floor or wall mounting.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: your current H1 says "Night Table" and lists only the 7602. Cortech calls it the "Nightstand," and your subtitle says "Night Stand," so I used "Nightstand" and added the 7609. Is that okay?
Weight: both variants are set to 29 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 26 lbs and gives one weight for both tops, so I used 26 lbs for the 7602. Should the 7609 also be 26 lbs?
Height: the spec sheet features list says 22” high, and the drawing shows 21.5”. I used 22”.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year factory warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime on the all-plastic nightstand and 5 years on the laminate top, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 6 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
I left out "can be wiped, mopped, or even hosed down," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say this.
Product images: the page has two images, and neither shows the 7609 laminate top. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
